Choose Flask for small services, APIs, and anything whose shape does not match Django's assumptions, or where you specifically want to pick your own ORM and components. For a brand new API today, also look at FastAPI, since async support and automatic validation are built in rather than added.

thread: > Choose Django if you are building a database-backed application with users, forms, and an admin area, because it ships all of that already integrated and you will spend your time on features rather than assembly.
Choose Flask for small services, APIs, and anything whose shape does not match Django's assumptions, or where you specifically want to pick your own ORM and components.
For a brand new API today, also look at FastAPI, since async support and automatic validation are built in rather than added.
